departments.speciality_maindescription:
The Department of Medical Gastroenterology and Hepatology at Sri Ramakrishna Specialty Hospital is dedicated to the diagnosis and treatment of a wide range of digestive and liver disorders. Our expert team offers compassionate, comprehensive care using advanced technologies and personalized treatment plans.

We manage conditions such as gastrointestinal diseases, liver disorders, inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), pancreatic issues, and gastrointestinal cancers. Our specialists are skilled in advanced diagnostic and therapeutic endoscopic procedures, including upper GI endoscopy, colonoscopy, ERCP with stenting, variceal banding, hemoclipping, esophageal stenting, polypectomy, and mucosal resection.
speciality_content01_list: Liver Disease Management (Hepatitis, Cirrhosis, Fatty Liver)
speciality_content02_list: Experienced Team: Skilled in managing complex GI and liver conditions
Advanced Technology: State-of-the-art diagnostic and therapeutic tools
Personalized Care: Tailored treatment with holistic patient support
departments.speciality_conclusion: Our mission is to provide high-quality, patient-focused care to help you achieve and maintain optimal digestive health.

departments.speciality_maindescription: Clinical Oncology is a specialized branch of medicine dedicated to the diagnosis, treatment, and management of cancer. At our center, we follow a multidisciplinary approach involving medical, surgical, and radiation therapies to provide comprehensive cancer care. Our team is committed to using the latest advancements to deliver personalized treatment tailored to each patient’s needs.
departments.speciality_content01_desciption: Our clinical oncology services include chemotherapy, targeted therapy, immunotherapy, and hormone therapy. Treatment plans are customized based on cancer type, stage, and the patient’s overall health.
speciality_content01_list: Chemotherapy - Medications that destroy or halt the growth of cancer cells
Targeted Therapy - Drugs that attack specific cancer cell markers
Immunotherapy - Boosts the immune system to fight cancer
Hormone Therapy - Blocks or removes hormones that fuel certain cancers
departments.speciality_content02_desciption: Our surgical oncology team performs precise tumor removal using advanced techniques that aim to preserve healthy tissues and promote faster recovery.
speciality_content02_list: Tumor Resection - Surgical removal of cancerous growths
Minimally Invasive Surgery - Laparoscopic procedures for quicker recovery
Sentinel Node Biopsy - To check cancer spread to lymph nodes
speciality_content03_list: Expert Team - Experienced oncologists skilled in modern cancer therapies
Personalized Care - Individualized treatment for better outcomes
Advanced Technology - Latest tools for accurate diagnosis and treatment
departments.speciality_conclusion: Complete Support from diagnosis to recovery, with counseling, nutrition, and education services
